sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "routes"."alid" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "routes" GROUP BY "routes"."alid"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
why: gap to the all average of number of routes records (all level)
